description: NearOptimalAlternatives.jl is a Julia package from the TulipaEnergy organisation, released on Zenodo by Germán Morales-España and Ni Wang of TNO with Grigory Neustroev, Luuk van de Laar, Matthijs Arnoldus and Mathijs de Weerdt of Delft University of Technology. It takes a solved JuMP.jl optimisation model and generates alternative solutions that are as different as possible from the optimum while staying within a set maximum deviation of the objective value. Alternatives can come from mathematical optimisation or from metaheuristic algorithms in Metaheuristics.jl. The README links stable and development documentation, test, lint and documentation workflows, coverage reports and a citation file. Release v0.1.1 is free under Apache-2.0 on Zenodo and GitHub, dated February 2026. Coverage is not tied to a region. Caveats: it is a generic tool, so infrastructure detail comes from the model it is applied to, and it is an early 0.1 release. Simulation uses are exploring near-cost-optimal alternative energy system or network expansion plans. Related records: model-spineopt and model-genx are energy system optimisation models that such alternatives can be generated from.
